title: Work work work
lyrics:
**[Intro]**
In the depths of our values, we stand tall
Uplifting mob, supporting all

**[Verse 1]**
We've walked through trials, faced medical strife
Children in need, our hearts on life
Serious situations forced us to take a stand
Clearing our path, with an open hand

**[Chorus]**
We will not be silenced, we will not be tamed
Our voices raised, for the cause we've claimed
Culturally safe spaces, where trust is key
We'll fight for what's right, till eternity

**[Verse 2]**
The original T.O.R., a foundation so strong
Facilitating discussions, all day long
Perceptions are reality, in a disharmony space
We won't be fooled, by forensic pace

**[Chorus]**
We will not be silenced, we will not be tamed
Our voices raised, for the cause we've claimed
Culturally safe spaces, where trust is key
We'll fight for what's right, till eternity

**[Verse 3]**
Open grievances, a different tale
Not our domain, we won't fail
THHS leads the way, with governance might
We support from afar, in cultural sight

**[Chorus]**
We will not be silenced, we will not be tamed
Our voices raised, for the cause we've claimed
Culturally safe spaces, where trust is key
We'll fight for what's right, till eternity

**[Bridge]**
We'll review and refine, our conflict and disharmony
Making recommendations, for a brighter harmony
Our values intact, we'll hold the line
For culturally safe workplaces, all the time

**[Chorus]**
We will not be silenced, we will not be tamed
Our voices raised, for the cause we've claimed
Culturally safe spaces, where trust is key
We'll fight for what's right, till eternity

title: Work work work
lyrics:
**Verse 1**
In the depths of scope, where terms collide
Ambiguity reigns, and expectations divide
Fahren and Greg, they stood tall and strong
Clarifying doubts, where standard practice went wrong

[Chorus]
United we stand, against the changing tide
With every word, our bond will never subside
Through the stormy night, we'll hold the line
Our cultural lens, shining bright and divine

**Verse 2**
Voluntary staff engagement, a safe haven to share
But Fahren's concerns, echoed through the air
Forensic investigation expectations, no room for guess
Explicitly stated, or forever in distress

[Chorus]
United we stand, against the changing tide
With every word, our bond will never subside
Through the stormy night, we'll hold the line
Our cultural lens, shining bright and divine

**Bridge**
From report preparation to document sharing too
Greg and Fahren's plan, is to see it through
Version control and collaboration, a seamless ride
With stakeholders' feedback, our work will thrive inside

[Verse 3]
Grievance handling, an art we must perform
Closed grievances reviewed, with timing no concern
Open grievances investigated, with research and recommendations in tow
Our team's expertise, will make the truth unfold

[Chorus]
United we stand, against the changing tide
With every word, our bond will never subside
Through the stormy night, we'll hold the line
Our cultural lens, shining bright and divine

**Outro**
We're the conduit for open dialogue and trust
Adapting to needs, with clear communication's just
In the project management game, we play by the rules
With hourly billing model, our expertise will cool
